findings.description: F-002: the stated controls include WASD and R, and the Game Over overlay reads «R — новая игра», but bind_keys() binds by Tk keysym, so under a Cyrillic keyboard layout — the default for this book's audience — WASD and R were dead keys. Verified: <KeyPress-Cyrillic_ka>, <KeyPress-R> and <KeyPress-Cyrillic_tse> all had no effect while <KeyPress-Up> and <KeyPress-space> worked.
findings.resolution: Extended bind_keys() in snake.py to also bind the shifted Latin forms (W A S D, R) and the ЙЦУКЕН counterparts of the same physical keys — Cyrillic_tse/yeru/ef/ve for WASD and Cyrillic_ka for restart, plus their uppercase keysyms — and added a docstring explaining that Tk binds by keysym and keysyms are layout-dependent. Verified by loading real X layouts (setxkbmap ru, then us) into the Xvfb server and pressing the physical keycodes: all five controls work under both layouts.
